    out = []
    field = ''

    while i < len(row):

                field += '""'
                i += 1
            else: quoted = not quoted

            field = ''
        else: field += c
        i += 1
    out.append(field)
    return out

    out = []

starter:
def solve(row):
    if not row: return []
    out = []
    field = ''
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c == '"':
            if quoted and i+1 < len(row) and row[i+1] == '"':
                field += '"'
                i += 1
            else: quoted = not quoted
        elif c == ',':
            out.append(field)
            field = ''
        else: field += c
        i += 1

def solve(row):
    if not row: return []
    out = []
    field = ''
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c == '"':
            if quoted and i+1 < len(row) and row[i+1] == '"':
                field += '""'
                i += 1
            else: quoted = not quoted
        elif c == ',' and not quoted:
            out.append(field)
            field = ''
        else: field += c
        i += 1
    out.append(field)
    return out

    if not row: return []
    out = []
    field = ''
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c == '"':
            if quoted and i+1 < len(row) and row[i+1] == '"':
                field += '"'
                i += 1
            else: quoted = not quoted
        elif c == ',':
            out.append(field)
            field = ''
        else: field += c
        i += 1
    out.append(field)
    return out

starter:
def solve(row):
    if not row: return []
    out = []
    field = ''
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c == '"':
            if quoted and i+1 < len(row) and row[i+1] == '"':
                field += '""'
                i += 1
            else: quoted = not quoted
        elif c == ',' and not quoted:
            out.append(field)
            field = ''
        else: field += c
        i += 1
    out.append(field)
    return out

starter:
def solve(row):
    if not row: return []
    out = []
    field = ''
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c == '"':
            if quoted and i+1 < len(row) and row[i+1] == '"':
                field += '"'
                i += 1
            else: quoted = not quoted
        elif c == ',':
            out.append(field)
            field = ''
        else: field += c
        i += 1
    out.append(field)

starter:
def solve(row):
    if not row: return []
    out = []
    field = ''
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c == '"':
            if quoted and i+1 < len(row) and row[i+1] == '"':
                field += '""'
                i += 1
            else: quoted = not quoted
        elif c == ',' and not quoted:
            out.append(field)
            field = ''
        else: field += c
        i += 1
    out.append(field)
    return out
